about_short_description.short_description: Incognia is a next-generation identity solution that solves complex fraud, risk, and abuse problems.

product.name: Incognia ID
product.description: A cross-device user recognition solution combining app security, device identity, and location intelligence to detect fraud and reduce false positives.

product.name: Location Identity Verification
product.description: A solution that verifies users and addresses by binding device insights, indoor location, and physical address data into a unique identifier for fraud prevention and onboarding.

product.name: Environment Linked to Fraud (ELF) Detection
product.description: A detection tool that flags devices as risky if they share indoor location signals with devices previously linked to fraud, helping stop recurring fraud and ban evasion.

product.name: Suspicious Locations
product.description: A feature that detects and flags high-risk micro-locations associated with clusters of fraudulent devices to prevent organized fraud operations.

product.name: Proof of Value (POV) Program
product.description: A trial program allowing potential customers to test Incognia’s SDK in production to evaluate fraud prevention impact and ROI without disrupting existing processes.
